name: liveshare-workspace-bridge
description: Edit Live Share workspaces with permission controls and an optional verified Host PowerShell bridge, without ports or copied tokens.

scripts.check: node --check extension.cjs && node --check workspace.cjs && node --check cli.cjs && node --check permissions.cjs && node --check host-channel.cjs && node --check host-operations.cjs && node --check patch.cjs && node --check ipc-access.cjs && node --check startup-diagnostics.cjs

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.powershell.description: Optional PowerShell executable override. Defaults to Windows PowerShell. IPC Access Mode controls additional machine-local users; the release default is ownerOnly.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.agent.enabled.markdownDescription: **Allow Agent Access** — Master switch for all shared-workspace operations. Disabling it takes effect on subsequent requests.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.terminal.enable.markdownDescription: **Allow Shared Host Terminal Access** — Enable Host-dependent operations. Connection binding creates and removes owned temporary handshake files. Turning this off blocks new Host work without rolling back dispatched work. Child commands retain their configured timeout.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.terminal.name.description: Exact name of the shared read/write PowerShell terminal. Leave empty only when there is exactly one eligible Live Share shared terminal. Ordinary Guest terminals are never selected.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.terminal.hostWo.description: Optional Host workspace path for the selected shared root. Otherwise the shared PowerShell current directory is verified using a random handshake file. No Host path is guessed.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.terminal.comman.description: Maximum time for a Host child command. Only the bridge-owned process tree is terminated on timeout.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.terminal.maxOut.description: Maximum retained characters per Host stdout/stderr stream. Excess output is drained and explicitly marked truncated.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.transfer.chunkB.description: Maximum raw bytes in one transfer chunk.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.transfer.idleTi.description: Idle lifetime of a Host transfer handle. Expired handles and owned upload staging files are released automatically.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.lis.markdownDescription: **List directories** — Allow the agent to list shared directories.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.rea.markdownDescription: **Read text** — Allow buffered text reads, batch reads and explicit provider verification.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.cre.markdownDescription: **Create text files** — Allow creation of new shared text files.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.wri.markdownDescription: **Replace whole documents** — Allow guarded full-document text replacement.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.edi.markdownDescription: **Edit text** — Allow text replacements and multi-file text edits.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.sav.markdownDescription: **Save documents** — Allow target-document saves, including saves performed by editing operations.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.mkd.markdownDescription: **Create directories** — Allow shared directory creation, including missing parent directories.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.cop.markdownDescription: **Copy files** — Allow byte-preserving file copies through the shared Host terminal. Host-backed operations also require #liveshareWorkspaceBridge.terminal.enabled#. Their effective access is off while terminal access is off; this configured preference is retained.

**Copy directories** — Allow directory copies through the shared Host terminal. Host-backed operations also require #liveshareWorkspaceBridge.terminal.enabled#. Their effective access is off while terminal access is off; this configured preference is retained.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.mov.markdownDescription: **Move and rename paths** — Allow moving or renaming shared files and directories.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.del.markdownDescription: **Delete files and empty directories** — Allow deletion of individual files and empty directories. Recursive deletion is not provided.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.sta.markdownDescription: **Read metadata** — Allow provider metadata and explicitly requested Host metadata.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.dia.markdownDescription: **Read diagnostics** — Allow reading language diagnostics for shared documents.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.sym.markdownDescription: **Read document symbols** — Allow document outline queries.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.wor.markdownDescription: **Read workspace symbols** — Allow language-aware workspace symbol queries.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.ren.markdownDescription: **Rename symbols** — Allow previewing and applying language-service symbol renames.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.sea.markdownDescription: **Search content** — Allow Host content search and explicitly selected editor snapshots. Host-backed operations also require #liveshareWorkspaceBridge.terminal.enabled#. Their effective access is off while terminal access is off; this configured preference is retained.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.fin.markdownDescription: **Find paths** — Allow Host path discovery and explicitly selected provider snapshots. Host-backed operations also require #liveshareWorkspaceBridge.terminal.enabled#. Their effective access is off while terminal access is off; this configured preference is retained.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.app.markdownDescription: **Apply text patches** — Allow checked Host Git text patches inside the bound workspace. Host-backed operations also require #liveshareWorkspaceBridge.terminal.enabled#. Their effective access is off while terminal access is off; this configured preference is retained.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.rea.markdownDescription: **Read bytes** — Allow byte-preserving Host reads and raw-byte hashes. Host-backed operations also require #liveshareWorkspaceBridge.terminal.enabled#. Their effective access is off while terminal access is off; this configured preference is retained.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.wri.markdownDescription: **Write bytes** — Allow byte-preserving Host writes with explicit overwrite rules. Host-backed operations also require #liveshareWorkspaceBridge.terminal.enabled#. Their effective access is off while terminal access is off; this configured preference is retained.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.lar.markdownDescription: **Upload large files** — Allow chunked Host file uploads. Write Bytes permission also applies. Large downloads are unavailable in v0.2 because sustained shared-terminal output did not pass live validation. Host-backed operations also require #liveshareWorkspaceBridge.terminal.enabled#. Their effective access is off while terminal access is off; this configured preference is retained.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.permissions.hos.markdownDescription: **Run Host commands** — Allow arbitrary commands in a bounded Host child process. Requires all other operation permissions because raw commands cannot enforce per-operation restrictions. Host-backed operations also require #liveshareWorkspaceBridge.terminal.enabled#. Their effective access is off while terminal access is off; this configured preference is retained.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.ipc.allowCodexS.deprecationMessage: Use IPC Access Mode. A previously enabled legacy setting migrates once to selectedUsers and pinned local account SIDs, never to allLocalUsers.
liveshareWorkspaceBridge.ipc.allowCodexS.markdownDescription: Legacy v0.2.1 compatibility only. Ignored when IPC Access Mode is explicitly configured. Migration pins the two existing sandbox accounts by SID; it does not create accounts or broaden trust.

enumDescriptions: Only the Windows user running VS Code (release default).
All current machine-local SAM user accounts, in the same Windows session. No remote or domain users.
Only the owner and selected machine-local user SIDs, in the same Windows session.
liveshareWorkspaceBridge.ipc.accessMode.markdownDescription: **IPC Access Mode** — Trust applies to every process under allowed accounts, not only Codex. Calls use bridge permissions outside Codex filesystem sandbox limits. Host access is independent; when enabled it may allow Host commands. Changes restart the bridge; rediscover afterward. Use Configure IPC Access to choose users.

liveshareWorkspaceBridge.ipc.selectedUse.markdownDescription: **Selected Local Account SIDs** — Used only by selectedUsers. Configure IPC Access displays names but saves stable SIDs. Renames keep access; deleted/recreated accounts are not substituted. Invalid, foreign and unavailable SIDs are never granted.
